name: commons
description: Memory shared across projects, by topic: turn topics on per project in a sidebar, and Claude reads and saves to them in any session.

memoryDir.title: Memory folder
memoryDir.description: Where the shared memory is kept, one file per memory. Empty means ~/.claude/commons. Keep it outside every repo.

contextLimit.title: Context size (characters)
contextLimit.description: Most characters of shared memory added to a conversation's first message; past it, the newest are kept and Claude recalls the rest.
